root_cause: A new account page was placed at an unclassified root path, so the protected delivery admission gate correctly failed. The next attempt had the page in the existing pages/ lane but lacked Brain learning, append-only development activity and human change documentation in the same material candidate. Adding a second function filename also changed the canonical Netlify function inventory, causing the protected portal explanation source/hash freshness check to fail before content tests. The initial checkout placed a literal public anchor to a noindex customer account, and the existing technical SEO gate correctly rejected it as a non-indexable internal canonical link. The strict offline localization build then rejected the new button label as one uncached translation; existing checkout button copy had already been translated. The original checkout browser regression expects an anchor after verified readiness; substituting a button would incorrectly break existing browser assurance.
fix: Move new account HTML into the existing classified pages/ website lane and update checkout/test to use its exact route; add one read-only authenticated SaaS entitlement endpoint and preserve the existing Netlify Identity/Stripe/Supabase authority; commit the required closure artifacts in the same PR lineage. Consolidate the new account response into the existing portal-entitlements function through two URL routes and the same verified handler, retaining the older organisation_id response only for the existing portal route; delete the duplicate function file. Use an accessible button with an explicit post-readiness click handler for the authenticated noindex route; the button remains hidden until Stripe readiness returns ready=true. Reuse the existing translated checkout label 'Verder naar mijn portaal →' rather than introduce an unverified translation or bypass static-i18n fail-closed. Restore the anchor while keeping its href absent in static public HTML; assign the full HTTPS destination only in the `data.ready===true` verified branch immediately before revealing the link.
prevention_rule: Before any new customer-facing file, classify its path under an existing delivery lane and require server-validated user+canonical tenant+active or trialing subscription; do not treat a checkout success flag, client-side plan lock, missing payment receipt or anonymous scan as authorization. Every material PR carries canonical Brain learning, ledger and documentation with executable tests. Required, CodeQL, preview and independent production acceptance must be green on exact SHA before LIVE. Existing shipped browser contracts must be audited before changing element semantics; a private, noindex destination may be bound only after server-verified readiness to preserve public SEO and keyboard link semantics.

invariants: no user or confirmed email => deny
tenant mismatch or inactive billing => deny
no paid access on provider outage
no new scheduler, billing store or payment charge

next_safe_action: Complete exact-head Required+CodeQL and Netlify preview; inspect any failed-stage logs; verify authenticated customer activation and two-tenant denial in real preview; only then use existing protected merge and production readback.
terminal_rule: No fake green. Zero authenticated customer readback or a failed build/required test means NOT_LIVE.
